scope: Release raw completed-run events alongside idle conversation message projections
Pin selected/active/approval conversations while preserving unsent drafts, attachment previews and queued prompts

cache.eviction: Remove rendered messages, runs, raw streams and progress for an eligible idle conversation; preserve metadata and all unsent work
cache.pinning: Current conversation from the real router, active runs and pending approvals are excluded from eviction
cache.lifecycle: Promote cached accesses and touch again after an asynchronous detail publishes, since its original cache reservation can be evicted during the request
cache.migration: No persistent chat-history deletion; evicted messages reload from the existing IPC history API

templateReferences.indexField: Optional encrypted body.templateReference scalar in the V2 manifest; validated as a nonnegative safe integer
templateReferences.computation: Compute references when a conversation body is serialized; loaded/edited checkpoints take precedence when allocating IDs
templateReferences.legacy: Old V2 entries lacking the projection are authenticated/read once on demand, with only the extracted reference retained. The next successful index commit preserves the projection. Missing/corrupt records fail instead of implying zero.
templateReferences.compatibility: No new store version or encrypted body format. Back up the entire local-agent directory and original credential key as before.

benchmark.scope: Actual generated conversation cache entry points with plain-state fixtures; original checkpoint scan versus indexed ID projection over identical real encrypted records
benchmark.limitations: Serialized projection bytes are not heap usage. ID timings exclude index load and save. Existing V2 indexes without projected references require a one-time lazy fallback. Active/selected/approval state is protected; this is not an absolute total-memory cap.

limitations: The idle budget is not a total process-memory cap: active/selected/approval state and unsent work remain protected
